assessments.reasoning: The questionnaire uses the non-neutral term 'JEFE/A DEL HOGAR' to identify the anchor person (Page 3, Question 1; Page 4, Section 1, Question 3), so neutral_anchor_term is false. No explicit selection rule or criterion for choosing the head of household or reference person is stated in the questionnaire (Note: interviewer manual M and methodological guide G were not supplied in this run), so explicit_selection_rule and rule_not_sex_age_authority are false. For household-level modules such as Section 2 (Características de la vivienda), the questionnaire does not record the respondent separately from the head of household nor explicitly state that any knowledgeable adult may respond, so respondent_separate_or_any_adult is false.
